definitions.explanation: The official clothing worn by members of armed forces, including the various types of dress and combat uniforms.

examples.japanese: {軍服|ぐんぷく}を{着|き}た{兵士|へいし}たち。
{博物館|はくぶつかん}に{昔|むかし}の{軍服|ぐんぷく}が{展示|てんじ}されていた。
examples.english: Old military uniforms were on display at the museum.

examples.japanese: {軍服|ぐんぷく}のデザインは{国|くに}や{時代|じだい}によって{大|おお}きく{異|こと}なる。
examples.english: Military uniform designs vary greatly depending on the country and era.

notes:
A compound of {軍|ぐん} (military) and {服|ふく} (clothing). Used in historical, military, and fashion contexts. Note the rendaku: {服|ふく} becomes {服|ぷく} after {軍|ぐん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軍服|ぐんぷく}を{着|き}る: to wear a military uniform
- {軍服|ぐんぷく}{姿|すがた}: figure in military uniform
- {旧日本軍|きゅうにほんぐん}の{軍服|ぐんぷく}: uniforms of the former Japanese military

RELATED WORDS:
- {制服|せいふく}: uniform — the general term for any uniform (school, company, etc.)
- {迷彩服|めいさいふく}: camouflage uniform — specifically patterned for concealment
- {戦闘服|せんとうふく}: combat uniform, battle dress — for field operations
